# ts-vibe
[Source code](https://github.com/yar1kpr0grammer/ts-vibe)

***

**Main file:** `src/index.ts`

## Scripts

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `npm run dev` | Starts the project in development mode with watch enabled |
| `npm start` | Runs the project once using tsx |
| `npm run build` | Compiles TypeScript files into the `dist` folder |
| `npm run prod` | Runs the compiled production build |


## Project Structure

```txt
src/   - source code
dist/  - compiled JavaScript output
```
